Effect: {Hand} [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (One of your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)

[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may place 1 card with [Gammamon] in its text from your hand as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card. Then, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 8000 DP or less. For each color in this Digimon's digivolution cards, add 1000 to this DP deletion effect's maximum.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When another Digimon is deleted, gain 1 memory.
Special Rule: ＜Overflow (-4)＞ (As this card moves from the battle area or under a card to another area, lose 4 memory.)
